name: uv
why: Python package and environment manager used by every just recipe

name: just
why: Task runner; `just check` is the repo gate
install: sudo snap install just --classic (or: cargo install just)

name: xsel
why: review-loop clipboard copy (pyperclip backend on X11; wl-copy on Wayland)
install: sudo apt install xsel (X11) or sudo apt install wl-clipboard (Wayland)
